from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from .models import ProcurementRFP, SealedTenderBid

corrected_code:
from asgiref.sync import async_to_sync
from channels.layers import get_channel_layer
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from .models import ProcurementRFP, SealedTenderBid

class SubmitTenderBidView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, rfp_id):
        rfp = ProcurementRFP.objects.get(id=rfp_id)
        amount = request.data.get('bid_amount')
        proposal_url = request.data.get('proposal_pdf_url')

        bid = SealedTenderBid.objects.create(
            rfp=rfp,
            vendor=request.user.vendor_profile,
            bid_amount=amount,
            proposal_url=proposal_url
        )

        # Strictly isolate broadcast to the authorized evaluation committee group
        channel_layer = get_channel_layer()
        async_to_sync(channel_layer.group_send)(
            f"rfp_{rfp_id}_evaluation_committee",
            {
                'type': 'tender.bid_placed',
                'vendor_id': bid.vendor.id,
                'amount': str(bid.bid_amount),
                'proposal_url': bid.proposal_url
            }
        )
        return Response({'status': 'bid_submitted', 'bid_id': bid.id})
